title: granule~
description: `lyonpotpourri/granule~` performs granular synthesis, generating basic or tuned grain clouds from waveform and window buffers supplied by `lyonpotpourri/function~`. Use `grist` to set cloud parameters such as event count and horizon, frequency and grain-size limits, pan boundaries, amplitude, and density; grains must also be enabled, with Pd’s DACs on, to produce output.
